requirement: An owner can add, edit and archive sedes
expected: Sedes saves name, place, hours, pickup and the address flag; the first sede becomes main and receives all units; up to 20 active sedes; a repeated name is refused in Spanish
preconditions: Store-locations migrations applied; verified store with SKUs
steps: Mi tienda → Sedes → Agregar sede twice; edit; try a 21st and a repeated name

requirement: Turning sedes on or off never changes a total
expected: After the first sede, every SKU's units are in it; archiving the last sede removes the split and keeps quantity_on_hand

requirement: Archiving a sede with units moves them first
expected: Archiving requires a destination while units remain; the units move through transfers and the sede disappears from Mostrador, the listing and the store page; archiving the main sede makes the destination main

requirement: The split always adds up to the total
expected: Any transaction that leaves the sedes not adding up to quantity_on_hand fails at commit

requirement: Movements without a sede go to the main sede first
expected: Imports, purchase requests, the table's ±1 and Admin changes add to the main sede and take from the main sede first, then the others in order; each movement records its split
steps: `tests/store-locations.sql` (allocation); import a file that lowers a SKU

requirement: Undo reverses the original split
expected: Undoing a sale taken from two sedes returns the units to those same sedes
preconditions: Two sedes; a sale that spans both

requirement: Units move between sedes
expected: Mover entre sedes moves units, keeps the total, refuses more than the origin has, and a retried request with the same key doesn't move twice

requirement: A count at a sede changes the total by the difference
expected: Contar en Centro with a new number changes Centro and the total by the difference; other sedes don't change; a stale version is refused

requirement: Inventario shows stock per sede
expected: Each SKU shows "Miraflores 3 · Centro de Lima 1" under its quantity; the SKU page has Stock por sede and history names the sede

requirement: Mostrador sells from the chosen sede
expected: The Sede select is remembered per device; availability is capped by that sede; the sale's units leave that sede; a retried batch key is bound to its sede
steps: Mostrador → Centro de Lima → sell BOSS-DS1; `tests/store-locations.sql` (bulk)

requirement: Offline Mostrador sales keep their sede
expected: A sale queued offline is recorded in the sede chosen when it was made

requirement: Stock por sede sheet
expected: The download has one "Stock <sede>" column per sede; uploading it counts each filled cell at its sede, skips blanks, reports unknown SKUs and invalid cells, and applies in requests of up to 200 SKU

requirement: The inventory export carries Stock por sede
expected: The CSV export has "Stock <sede>" columns for stores with sedes and no extra columns otherwise

requirement: Listings show where the item is
expected: With two or more active sedes and units, the listing shows "Disponible en Miraflores y Centro de Lima" and Ver sedes; with one sede or none nothing changes; per-sede quantities never appear

requirement: Buyers choose where to pick up
expected: ¿Dónde lo recoges? lists sedes with pickup on; the choice is added to the WhatsApp message; leaving it on "Lo decido con la tienda" adds nothing

requirement: Addresses are private unless the store shows them
expected: The listing and store page show a sede's address only when Mostrar la dirección is on; public functions never return hidden addresses or other stores' data
preconditions: Two sedes, one with a hidden address

requirement: The store page lists its sedes
expected: /tiendas/<slug> shows each active sede with place, hours and the public address

requirement: Only the owner manages sedes
expected: Another user, anon or a suspended store cannot read the owner's sedes or call any sede function

requirement: Receipts stay off without the key
expected: Without LARIA_EINVOICE_KEY the Comprobantes page says it is not available, Mostrador shows no Comprobante box, and the route answers 503 EINVOICE_OFF

requirement: A verified store connects its Nubefact account
expected: RUTA and TOKEN are checked with Nubefact before saving; a wrong pair is refused with Nubefact's reason in Spanish; afterwards only the token's last four characters show
steps: Comprobantes → paste RUTA and TOKEN → Conectar

requirement: The token never reaches a browser
expected: The token is sealed with AES-256-GCM bound to the store id; get_einvoice_settings never returns it; authenticated users cannot select the ciphertext; a ciphertext from another store doesn't open

requirement: Mostrador issues a boleta in one tap
expected: With Boleta chosen, Registrar venta y emitir boleta records the sale, then issues B001-n through the store's Nubefact; the outcome shows status, Ver PDF and WhatsApp
steps: Mostrador → add SKU → Boleta → Registrar venta y emitir

requirement: Facturas need RUC and razón social
expected: A factura without a valid RUC (11 digits starting 10, 15, 17 or 20) or razón social is refused before any number is taken

requirement: Boletas from S/ 700 need the customer's document
expected: A boleta of S/ 700 or more without document and name is refused; DNI must have 8 digits

requirement: Numbers are never repeated or skipped by retries
expected: Concurrent receipts get consecutive numbers; one receipt per sale; preparing the same sale again returns the same receipt

requirement: A retry never issues twice
expected: When Nubefact says the document exists or doesn't answer, Laria looks it up first and records what it finds

requirement: Only the server records Nubefact's answer
expected: record_store_receipt_result is service_role only; an accepted or voided receipt is never downgraded; only https links are kept

requirement: Comprobantes lists what was issued
expected: Each receipt shows type, number, status, customer, lines, total and PDF; failed ones offer Reintentar

requirement: Accepted receipts can be voided for 7 days
expected: Anular asks for a reason and sends a comunicación de baja; older receipts can't be voided; stock doesn't change

requirement: Offline sales keep their receipt
expected: A sale queued offline with Boleta issues the boleta when it goes through
